ordinary_dividends_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 1a, total ordinary dividends (box 5 is included in this amount by the form's own instruction). Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.

qualified_dividends_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 1b, qualified dividends — taxed at the capital-gains rates through the QDCGT worksheet. Never more than box 1a. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated (ordinary rates apply). Never negative.

capital_gain_distributions_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 2a, total capital gain distributions — Form 1040 line 7 without Schedule D when this is the only capital gain. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.

unrecaptured_1250_gain_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 2b, unrecaptured section 1250 gain — a 25%-rate slice INSIDE box 2a, so never more than it. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.

federal_withholding_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 4, federal income tax withheld. Optional — blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated. Reaches Form 1040 line 25b, inside 25d. Never negative.

section_199a_dividends_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 5, section 199A dividends — included in box 1a, and the input to the 20% qualified business income deduction (Form 1040 line 13). Never more than box 1a. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated (the deduction goes unclaimed). Never negative.

exempt_interest_dividends_cents.description: 1099-DIV box 12, exempt-interest dividends — Form 1040 line 2a, and inside the MAGI that phases out the senior deduction on line 12. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.
